parsed.name: EPICS过程变量记录器
parsed.description: 一种用于实验控制系统的监测与记录软件组件，用来跟踪EPICS过程变量（PV）的连接状态、数值变化、描述信息和时间戳，并将这些数据写入日志或数据队列，便于实验运行记录、状态审计和后续分析。
parsed.description_en: A monitoring and logging software component for laboratory control systems that tracks EPICS process variables (PVs), including connection status, value changes, descriptions, and timestamps, and writes them to logs or data queues for run records, status auditing, and later analysis.
